<js>
(function() {
let novelId = java.hexDecodeToString(result)
let type = JSON.parse(baseUrl.slice(baseUrl.indexOf('{'))).type

if (type == 'novel') {
  book.type = 8
  let loginInfo = JSON.parse(source.getLoginInfo() || '{}')
  loginInfo.书籍ID = novelId
  source.putLoginInfo(JSON.stringify(loginInfo))
} else if (type == 'comic') {
  book.type = 64
} else if (type == 'audio') {
  book.type = 32
}

// 主目录和普通章节仍走 qd.vv9v.cn；彩蛋只走 qdApi/qdList。
let catalog = requestApiUrl(`/${type}/catalog`, { novelId }) || []

let midpageEnabled = false
let midpageEntries = []
try {
  let m = source.getLoginInfoMap ? source.getLoginInfoMap() : null
  let v = m && (m.get ? m.get("\u5f69\u86cb\u7ae0\u5f00\u5173") : m["\u5f69\u86cb\u7ae0\u5f00\u5173"])
  midpageEnabled = type === 'novel' && v != null && String(v) === "✅"
  let listFn = typeof qdList === 'function' ? qdList : function(x) { return Array.isArray(x) ? x : [] }
  if (midpageEnabled && typeof qdApi === 'function') {
    let midRes = qdApi.call(this, 'midpage_chapters', { book_id: novelId }) || {}
    let midData = midRes.data || midRes.Data || (midRes.raw && (midRes.raw.Data || midRes.raw.data)) || {}
    let midpageList = listFn(midData.Chapters || midData.chapters || midData.DataList || midData.MidpageChapters || midData.MidPageChapters)
    for (let mp of midpageList) {
      mp = mp || {}
      let targetId = mp.ChapterId || mp.C || mp.chapterId
      if (!targetId) continue
      let eggs = listFn(mp.MidpageList || mp.MidPageList || mp.PageList || mp.Pages || mp.List)
      if (!eggs.length) continue
      for (let egg of eggs) {
        try {
          egg = egg || {}
          let cfg = egg.MidPageConfig || egg.MidpageConfig || {}
          let eggName = egg.MidPageName || egg.MidpageName || egg.Title || egg.RoleName || cfg.PageName || cfg.Title || "彩蛋内容"
          eggName = String(eggName).replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').replace(/^彩蛋章[ ·]*/, '')
          let midpageId = egg.PageId || egg.MidPageId || egg.MidpageId || cfg.PageId || cfg.MidPageId || ''
          if (!midpageId) continue
          let chapterId = String(targetId)
          midpageId = String(midpageId)
          let eggKey = 'midpage:' + String(novelId) + ':' + chapterId + ':' + midpageId
          let eggUrl = `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(String(eggKey))},{"type":"novel","novelId":"${String(novelId)}","chapterId":"${chapterId}","qimoType":"midpage","midpageId":"${midpageId}"}`
          midpageEntries.push({
            id: eggKey,
            name: '彩蛋章 · ' + eggName,
            url: String(eggUrl),
            info: '官方插图/视频',
            isVolume: false,
            isVip: false,
            isPay: false
          })
        } catch (entryError) {
          try { java.log('忽略异常彩蛋数据: ' + entryError.message) } catch (_) {}
        }
      }
    }
  }
} catch (e) {
  midpageEnabled = false
  midpageEntries = []
  try { java.log('彩蛋 qdApi 处理失败，忽略彩蛋：' + e.message) } catch (_) {}
}

let cache = (requestApiUrl(`/${type}/cache`, { novelId }) || []).reduce((acc, d) => {
  acc[d.chapId] = d
  return acc
}, {})

function fmtTime(timestamp) {
  let date = new Date(timestamp)
  let year = date.getFullYear()
  let month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
  let day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
  let hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')
  let minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')
  return `${year}-${month}-${day} ${hours}:${minutes}`
}

let chaps = []
if (type === 'novel') {
  for (let volumeIndex = 0; volumeIndex < catalog.length; volumeIndex++) {
    let volume = catalog[volumeIndex] || {}
    let volumeKey = 'volume:' + String(novelId) + ':' + String(volumeIndex)
    chaps.push({
      id: volumeKey,
      name: volume.volumeName,
      url: `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(volumeKey)},{"type":"volume"}`,
      isVolume: true
    })
    for (let chapter of (volume.chapters || [])) {
      let { chapId, chapName, charCount, isVip, isBuy, displayTime } = chapter
      let isShare = cache[chapId]
      chaps.push({
        id: chapId,
        name: (isVip ? (isBuy ? ' 🔑 ' : isShare ? '  🍋 ' : '') : '') + chapName,
        url: `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(chapId)},{"type":"${type}","novelId":"${novelId}"}`,
        info: `${fmtTime(displayTime)} | ${charCount || 0}字 ${isShare ? '  🍋 ' : isBuy ? ' 🔑 ' : ''}`,
        isVip: !isShare && isVip,
        isPay: !!isBuy,
      })

    }
  }
}

if (midpageEnabled && midpageEntries.length) {
  let midpageVolumeKey = 'volume:' + String(novelId) + ':midpage'
  chaps.push({
    id: midpageVolumeKey,
    name: '彩蛋章',
    url: `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(midpageVolumeKey)},{"type":"volume"}`,
    isVolume: true
  })
  chaps = chaps.concat(midpageEntries)
}

return JSON.stringify(chaps)
})();
</js>
